blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Janssen Biotech, Inc. Attention: Donna Kipphorn Associate Director, Global Regulatory Affairs, Immunology Welsh & McKean Roads, PO Box 776 Spring House, PA 19477
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Dear Ms. Kipphorn:
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Please refer to your Supplemental Biologics License Application (sBLA), dated and received December 16, 2016, submitted under section 351(a) of the Public Health Service Act for Stelara ® (ustekinumab).
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: We acknowledge receipt of your risk evaluation and mitigation strategy (REMS) assessment, dated December 16, 2016.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for a request for release from the REMS.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: APPROVAL & LABELING
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: We have completed our review of this supplemental application. It is approved, effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the enclosed, agreed-upon labeling text.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: CONTENT OF LABELING
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: As soon as possible, but no later than 14 days from the date of this letter, submit, via the FDA automated drug registration and listing system (eLIST), the content of labeling [21 CFR 601.14(b)] in structured product labeling (SPL) format, as described at http://www.fda.gov/ForIndustry/DataStandards/StructuredProductLabeling/default.htm, that is identical to the enclosed labeling (text for the prescribing information and Medication Guide) and include the labeling changes proposed in any pending "Changes Being Effected" (CBE) supplements. Information on submitting SPL files using eLIST may be found in the guidance for industry titled "SPL Standard for Content of Labeling Technical Qs and As" at http://www.fda.gov/downloads/Drugs/GuidanceComplianceRegulatoryInformation/Guidances/U CM072392.pdf.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The SPL will be accessible via publicly available labeling repositories.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Food and Drug Administration
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Silver Spring MD 20993
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: SUPPLEMENT APPROVAL
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: page_footer
blocks.text: Reference ID: 4056475
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: page_header
blocks.text: BLA 125261/S-129 Page 2
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Also within 14 days, amend all pending supplemental applications that include labeling changes for this BLA, including pending "Changes Being Effected" (CBE) supplements, for which FDA has not yet issued an action letter, with the content of labeling [21 CFR 601.12(f)] in MS Word format that includes the changes approved in this supplemental application.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: We request that the labeling approved today be available on your website within 10 days of receipt of this letter.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: REQUIRED PEDIATRIC ASSESSMENTS
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Under the Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA) (21 U.S.C. 355c), all applications for new active ingredients, new indications, new dosage forms, new dosing regimens, or new routes of administration are required to contain an assessment of the safety and effectiveness of the product for the claimed indication(s) in pediatric patients unless this requirement is waived, deferred, or inapplicable.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Because none of these criteria apply to your application, you are exempt from this requirement.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: RISK EVALUATION AND MITIGATION STRATEGY REQUIREMENTS
section_path: RISK EVALUATION AND MITIGATION STRATEGY REQUIREMENTS
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The REMS for Stelara (ustekinumab) was originally approved on September 25, 2009, and the most recent modification was approved on May 2, 2012. The REMS consists a communication plan, and a timetable for submission of assessments of the REMS. Your proposed modification to the REMS consists of a request to be released from the REMS.
section_path: RISK EVALUATION AND MITIGATION STRATEGY REQUIREMENTS
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Therefore, because the communication plan and assessments are no longer necessary to ensure the benefits of the drug outweigh the risks, a REMS is no longer required for Stelara® (ustekinumab).
section_path: RISK EVALUATION AND MITIGATION STRATEGY REQUIREMENTS
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: REPORTING REQUIREMENTS
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: We remind you that you must comply with reporting requirements for an approved BLA (in 21 CFR 600.80 and in 21 CFR 600.81).
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have any questions, call Dawn Williams, Regulatory Project Manager, at (301) 796-5376.
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.text: Sincerely,
